title: Kühlung Hills and Baltic Balcony
slogan: A 102 km loop out of Bad Doberan minster
story: The Rostock escape that actually feels like a ride. This road trip is shaped as a ride, not as a shortcut: leave the start cleanly, use the first checkpoint for fuel and weather discipline, then let the middle 41 km be the part you remember. The best part sits around Bad Doberan minster, Kühlungsborn sea road, Rerik coast view, while the fuel checkpoint and the food stop keep the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel hunt. Check the selected map before departure: scenic sections, transfer sections, speed/control reminders, risk points and the GPX checkpoint order are deliberately visible so the route is understandable before the engine starts. Ride it early if the area is popular, keep the photo stops legal, and shorten the route if weather, daylight or energy stops agreeing with the plan.

scenicChapters.title: Baltic Coast Scenic Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 19 km this is Baltic Coast Scenic Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Baltic Coast Scenic Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 19 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
